input_constraints: Pinned USA default.xbe or a verified composition; reserve the entire selected owner union before applying any grown owner.
A successful manual Save Franchise or Load Franchise chooses the current device and full save name. A new franchise needs one manual save.
Auto Save must be On. Only completed native Franchise games qualify; saving waits for two quiet topmost Coach's Desk updates after game teardown.

Reuses the former First Person Football word in the native Franchise save. Loading an old save with that word set enables Auto Save; loading an Auto Save save in retail reinterprets it as First Person Football.
